description: Real Seasons is a Fabric mod for Minecraft Java Edition that adds a complete, fully automatic four-season cycle to the game. Every world now progresses through Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter
body:
# Real Seasons

A Fabric mod that brings a fully automatic four-season system to Minecraft.

Every world naturally progresses through **Spring**, **Summer**, **Autumn**, and **Winter**. By default, each season lasts **7 Minecraft days** before automatically changing to the next one. All season data is saved with the world and synchronized between the server and all connected players.

---

## 🌸 Spring

* Frequent rain
* Crops grow **20% faster**
* Mild temperatures

## ☀️ Summer

* Long sunny days
* Rare thunderstorms
* Crops grow **30% faster**
* Sprinting consumes more hunger

## 🍂 Autumn

* Moderate rain
* Falling leaf particles
* Increased apple drops from oak leaves
* Weather gradually becomes colder

## ❄️ Winter

* Rain becomes snow
* Water freezes naturally
* Crops grow **50% slower**
* More hostile mobs spawn at night
* Random blizzards
* Rare **Harsh Winter** event

---

## 🌡 Body Temperature

Players have a body temperature ranging from **0°C** to **100°C**.

Temperature decreases during:

* Winter
* Night
* Snowfall
* Cold biomes
* Blizzards

Temperature increases near:

* Campfires (+20)
* Lava (+15)
* Furnaces (+10)
* Fire (+12)
* Magma Blocks (+8)

Effects:

* **Below 30°C** – Slowness and faster hunger drain.
* **Below 10°C** – Freezing damage.
* **0°C** – Extreme freezing damage and severe movement slowdown.

---

## 🖥 HUD

The built-in HUD displays:

* Current season
* Season day
* Body temperature
* Active weather
* Blizzard warnings
* Harsh Winter warnings

The HUD can be moved, resized or disabled.

---

## 🎮 Hotkeys

**H** — Seasons Menu

**J** — Calendar

**K** — Detailed Information

**N** — Toggle HUD

**B** — Environment Temperature

---

## ⚙ Commands

```text
/season get
/season set <spring|summer|autumn|winter>
/season next
/season freeze
/season resume
/season reload
/season day add <value>
/season temperature get
/season temperature set <value>
/season storm start
/season storm stop
/season winter harsh start
/season winter harsh stop
```

---

## 🔧 Configuration

Everything can be configured inside:

```text
config/realseasons.json
```

Available settings include:

* Season duration
* Weather chances
* Temperature speed
* Blizzard chance
* Harsh Winter chance
* HUD position
* HUD scale
* Freezing damage
* Visual effects

Reload the configuration instantly using:

```text
/season reload
```

---

## 🏆 Advancements

The mod includes **9 custom advancements**, including:

* Experience every season
* Complete a full year
* Survive a Harsh Winter
* Reach critical body temperature
* Warm yourself at a campfire before freezing
* And more...

---

## 🚀 Performance

Optimized for both singleplayer and multiplayer.

* Cached calculations
* Optimized tick checks
* Efficient chunk processing
* Low network usage
* Fast server synchronization

---

## ✅ Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.21.4**
* Fabric Loader
* Singleplayer
* Multiplayer
* Dedicated Servers

---

## 🌍 Languages

* English
* Русский
